GBA Mega overworld pixel art and native walking frames: rh-hideout/pokeemerald-expansion.
https://github.com/rh-hideout/pokeemerald-expansion/tree/master/graphics/pokemon/blastoise/mega
Original contributor attribution: https://github.com/rh-hideout/pokeemerald-expansion/blob/master/CREDITS.md
Four-direction walking poses are sequenced for idle and battle actions; attack motion/effects are provided by this app. No claim of native GBA attack animation.
